old_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a smooth, dark chocolate surface resting on a white parchment paper. The chocolate has a glossy finish, reflecting light and creating a rainbow-like iridescent effect along its edges. The scene remains static, with no camera movement. Small, thin chocolate shavings or flakes are visible scattered across the parchment paper near the edge of the chocolate slab. The overall scene is static, with only the subtle, slow diffusion of the iridescent effect across the chocolate's surface being visible.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a smooth, dark chocolate surface resting on a white parchment paper. The chocolate has a glossy finish, reflecting light and creating a rainbow-like iridescent effect along its edges. The camera slowly pans to the left, revealing more of the chocolate's surface and the texture of the parchment paper beneath it. As the camera continues to move, small, thin chocolate shavings or flakes become visible scattered across the parchment paper near the edge of the chocolate slab. The camera movement is smooth and steady, providing a detailed view of the chocolate's texture and the subtle interplay of light and shadow on its surface. The overall scene remains static except for the camera's gradual pan, which allows viewers to appreciate the intricate details of the chocolate and the surrounding environment.
caption: A glossy dark-brown sheet lies on a white paper-like surface, its scalloped, wavy edge running diagonally across the frame. Bright rainbow iridescent reflections trace the undulating edge, while small bubble-like dots scatter across the brown surface and a few thin curved shavings rest on the white area below. The viewpoint drifts slowly laterally, carrying the wavy edge, the shavings, and the dot marks together toward the right and upward without changing their spacing. As the angle shifts, the colored reflection bands slide and reshape along the edge, their hues brightening and dimming while the scalloped geometry itself stays fixed. A separate brown lump slides into view at the far left border, becoming a persistent partial object there. The pan continues across the sheet, leaving the iridescent edge and surface marks in steady motion.
